correctness.rationale: One-coordinate antiderivative generator tests give the three conditional laws exactly. Each coordinate speed is then an orthogonal conditional residual, so the three variance-speed decompositions follow from the law of total variance. Stationarity of the centered products YZ and XZ eliminates the intermediate covariances and gives the displayed exact formula for Cov(Z,Phi(Z)). Strict decrease of the Hill function makes this covariance strictly negative whenever Z is nonconstant; constant Z propagates through the linear chain to the unique equilibrium, so every non-equilibrium invariant state has the strict sharpened gap. The packaged checker independently verifies the covariance elimination and all coefficient comparisons.

value.rationale: The Goodwin oscillator is a canonical sequential negative-feedback model in which degradation rates are known to control period and waveform. The accepted result turns that architecture into an exact fluctuation budget: every stage loses precisely coordinate-speed energy from the upstream variance. The feedback loop adds a nonlocal constraint that is stronger than the final linear filter alone, and the improvement factor is an explicit function of all three degradation rates. This provides an attractor-independent consistency diagnostic for measured or simulated oscillations and quantifies how monotone transcriptional repression further suppresses downstream repressor variance.
